name: Just a Minute™ Wear Watch Face

android.desc:
Just a Minute™ is a minute-forward watch face design for Wear OS! Tell the time, track your steps, customize your integrated weather report, and express yourself with color using the new Palette Designer.

Stuck in meetings all day and wonder how many minutes are left? Waiting for the bus you know comes in a few minutes? Just glance at your watch to see the minutes past the hour.

*While many more features are now available for free, some features require a subscription to Just a Minute Premium

FREE FEATURES
Customizable minute-forward watch face design. Change fonts, 24 hour mode, date format, phone + watch battery indicator, and more!

PREMIUM FEATURES
Weather: customize your integrated weather report with nowcast, auto-location, and temperature units (Fahrenheit, Celsius).

Fitness: track your steps or progress to your daily goal.

Palette Designer: customize the color scheme either individually using the Color Picker, or match colors from a photo using Snap2Wear™, and save your color creations as a palette in the gallery.

Just a Minute - make every minute count

☆☆☆ Compatibility ☆☆☆
Just a Minute is compatible with most smartwatches running Wear OS 2.X / 3.X / 4.X. Smartwatches shipped with Wear OS 5.X, including Google Pixel 3 and the Samsung Galaxy Watch7 series, are not currently supported. Read more here:
https://link.squeaky.dog/shipped-with-wearos5

☆☆☆ Staying in Touch ☆☆☆

Join the **Just a Minute** community and stay up to date with feature development and other valuable information. Sign up for Just a Minute Insiders here: 

https://link.squeaky.dog/jam-signup. 

We do not send many emails and you can unsubscribe at any time.

If you're looking for help with Just a Minute, please see our online knowledge base:

https://link.squeaky.dog/just-a-minute-help

Or you can open a support ticket by emailing us at support@squeaky.dog.

quotes.text: Me and my husband had been developing our own Android apps published to Google Play for a while and never made much money. But when Android Wear first came out, we started developing watch faces (mostly ones we wanted for ourselves) and persistence finally paid off. Income varies, but we've been steadily making between $500 and $1500/month. These are the top two: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sparkistic.justaminute and https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sparkistic.photowear
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Those making $500+/month on side projects in 2017 – Show and tell
